# Background 

Ion concentrations in Puerto Rico Streams before and after Hurricane Hugo.



# Data
Data is downloaded from: 
Data for each stream is seperated into different .csv files. 


```{r}
# load package
library(tidyverse)
read_csv("output/output.csv")
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  streams_pivot,
  mapping = aes(
    x = window_start,
    y = mean_concentration,
    color = stream,
    linetype = stream
  )
) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ion, scales = "free", ncol = 1, ) +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "ion concentration",
    title = " Concentrations in PR Streams"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = ymd("1989-09-17"), color = "darkgrey") +
  theme_bw()
```
